description: Heroicons v2 as typed, tree-shakeable Svelte 5 components: every 24px icon in the outline and solid styles, as named imports like BeakerIcon or through a generic Icon component with a typed name prop.
rules: Install @krowten/svelte-heroicons and import icons by name: import { BeakerIcon } from '@krowten/svelte-heroicons'. There is no @heroicons/svelte package.

Component names are heroicons v2 names in PascalCase plus Icon (arrow-up-tray → ArrowUpTrayIcon). Heroicons v1 names such as LogoutIcon or SearchIcon do not exist; look up the v2 name on heroicons.com.
Pass solid for the filled style: <BeakerIcon solid />. Only the 24px outline and solid styles are included, not the 20px mini or 16px micro ones.
Icons render at 24x24 by default; size them with CSS, e.g. class="size-5", and color them with text color, since they use currentColor.
Use <Icon name="beaker" /> only when the icon name is known at runtime: it bundles every icon, while named imports are tree-shaken.
Icons are aria-hidden by default; give an icon that carries meaning an aria-label and it is exposed as role="img".
